**When AI agent must escalate to human**

- Customer explicitly asks for a human agent → immediate handoff, no questions asked.
- Contract terms, custom pricing, refunds, legal/compliance wording → sales / billing team.
- P1 technical fault with impact on live business → support team + PSTN network team if carrier-side.
- After 2 consecutive KB misses on the same topic → escalate rather than guess.
